summary.text: Dale Helwig is a Republican member of the Kansas House of Representatives who has represented District 1 since January 2025 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: Helwig earned an associate degree from Coffeyville Community College in 1993 and a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University in 1995, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a cattle rancher, in construction and in the HVAC industry.
Helwig assumed office on January 13, 2025, succeeding Michael Houser.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Elections, Legislative Modernization, Water, and Welfare Reform committees.
